rw.name: CubeSpace CubeWheel CW0057 (Gen2) (RW, one of 3)
assumptions: rotor mass 0.4 x unit mass, balance ISO 1940 G2.5 (imbalance model)
friction: Coulomb 1e-5 sqrt(h / 0.01 Nms) N m, viscous 1e-8 N m s (not on datasheets)
motor: no-load speed 1.25 x the top stated speed, the line through the stated torque there (k_t = V / w_nl, R = k_t V / stall torque, V = the lowest stated supply)
breakaway friction 1.5 x Coulomb, Stribeck speed 1 rad/s (Bialke 1998; not on datasheets)

sizing.rule: lightest selectable catalogue model meeting the per-unit need (then steady power, volume)

cmg.name: Tensor Tech ADCS400 (4 x RS100 variable-speed CMG pyramid) (CMG, one cluster of 4 rotors)
cmg.model: ADCS400 (4 x RS100 variable-speed CMG pyramid)
assumptions: speed at the nominal momentum: 6000 rpm (not stated)
volume: 0.2 L per unit (datasheet: '0.2U+ tuna can')
rotor mass 0.4 x unit mass, balance ISO 1940 G2.5 (imbalance model)
friction: Coulomb 1e-5 sqrt(h / 0.01 Nms) N m, viscous 1e-8 N m s (not on datasheets)
gimbal rate: output torque / rotor momentum
rotor torque: 0.2 x output torque
gimbal power inside the steady power (the datasheet's figure is the whole unit)
as a VSCMG the rotor runs at half its momentum so the speed can move both ways (h_max = the datasheet's)
